objections.claim: At candidate artifact sha256:490b3b4683f60bf82ccd441260d585fab2cd94edd716545fffae48923529aff3, E6 defers its sound deterministic discriminator to an Argo implementation spike solely under a claimed Gemini referee ruling at `referee-adjudications/2026-08-28-e6-oracle-determinism.json`, but that record does not exist anywhere in the repository. Its provenance, exact ruling, scope, and Eye acceptance are therefore unverifiable. Without an authenticated ruling, the candidate leaves governance correction d unresolved: its interim repeated-evaluation fallback cannot exclude deterministic clock/entropy-keyed nondiscriminating oracles. The adjudication must exist as governed disk evidence before it can authorize this deferral, or E6 must specify a sound discriminator in the approach.
